tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find rankings, products, books, categories and articles by name or topic. Returns slugs to pass to the other tools, and page URLs to cite.

tools.name: list_rankings
tools.description: Without arguments: every category with its list count. With a category slug: that category's ranked lists and their top picks.

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: One ranked list (for example password-managers): criteria, how to choose, and every entry with rank, editorial score (0-100), verdict, best-for and key facts. Optionally narrowed by a filter such as free, open-source, linux.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Facts about one product or book: pricing model, platforms, open-source status, strengths, limits, every ranking it appears in and its top alternatives.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Products that share a ranking with the given one, best first, with why each is worth considering. Can be restricted to free, open-source or a platform.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Two products side by side: facts, plain-language differences, and the rank, score and verdict each gets in every ranking both appear in.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_ranking" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: One ranked list (for example password-managers): criteria, how to choose, and every entry with rank, editorial score (0-100), verdict, best-for and key facts. O…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog · Private data: get_ranking · Public sink: find_alternatives.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog · Private data: get_ranking · Public sink: find_alternatives

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
